name: Yearly ZCTA-Level Stratified Counts
description: Annual ZCTA-level MBSF denominator beneficiary and MedPAR admission counts stratified by age group, sex, race, RTI race and ethnicity, dual eligibility, HMO enrollment, and buy-in status.

content.race_rti: VARCHAR: RTI race and ethnicity classification
content.n_adm__65plus: DOUBLE: Number of admissions among beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_adm__disabled: DOUBLE: Number of admissions among disabled beneficiaries
content.n_adm__ffs65plus: DOUBLE: Number of Fee-for-Service admissions among beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_bene__65plus: DOUBLE: Number of beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_bene__ffs65plus: DOUBLE: Number of Fee-for-Service beneficiaries age 65 or older
